A few useful details

Before we connect.

What should I include in my enquiry?

The project location, the service you need, your expected timeline and any available technical requirements are a helpful starting point.

Can we discuss more than one service?

Yes. Select “General enquiry / multiple services” and describe the requirements you would like to discuss.

Does this form send my message automatically?

No. It prepares a message on your device. You choose email or WhatsApp, review it there and send it yourself. You can also copy the text or contact us directly.

Where is JAL TELECOM based?

Our supplied business address is in Bairro Onjivia, Belas, Luanda, Angola, near Toyota. Contact the team before arranging a visit.
